sentences.text: This is first application filed u/S. 439 of the Cr.P.C. by the petitioner for grant of bail.

The petitioner has been arrested 13.04.2024 by Police Station Baheriya District Sagar in connection with Crime No.148/2024 registered in relation to offences punishable u/Ss. 366, 376 (D), 506 of the IPC.
Petitioner is alleged with gang rape along with other co-accused persons.
The statement of victim under sections 161 and 164 of Cr.P.C. are implicative in nature.
It would be appropriate that the victim is allowed to be examined in the Court before request for bail is cancelled or if the trial gets further delayed whichever is earlier.
With the aforesaid liberty, bail application stands rejected.
